changes: Self-host linked worktrees now reject a stale main/global Lattice runtime before command lookup, handlers, hooks, validation, or mutation; diagnostics emit stale_global_runtime_in_worktree plus one shell-safe worktree-local node bin/lattice.js recovery command. Runtime facts, guards, docs, and both fingerprint contracts are synchronized.
usage: From a Proofbound story worktree, use node bin/lattice.js <command>. If a stale global lattice entrypoint is invoked, copy and run the emitted cd -- <worktree> && node bin/lattice.js <same arguments> recovery command; only explicitly tagged global-fallback session_brief is exempt.
expectedOutcome: A correct worktree-local runtime emits no authority-specific success banner and the requested command proceeds with its normal output. A stale global self-host invocation is blocked before dispatch with reason stale_global_runtime_in_worktree, executes zero handlers, and prints one safe local recovery command.
actualTranscript: Correct worktree-local runtime: no extra authority banner; the requested command executed normally. Stale global runtime: blocked with stale_global_runtime_in_worktree before handlers and returned the worktree-local recovery command.
outcomeDiff: No functional difference from the refined expected outcome. The absence of an extra success banner is intentional design: authority is silent on success and diagnostic only on stale-runtime failure.
limitations: Review assurance is degraded-single-host rather than full two-host quorum because real host CLI routing stalled; root npm test passed but took 844.5 seconds with poor subtest progress visibility.
pitfalls: A stale global CLI initially validated the wrong runtime; the new guard prevents recurrence. DONE-required first exposed two unsynchronized fingerprint literals, fixed in-story. Routine validation then passed 45/45 and DONE-required passed; avoid rerunning unchanged suites because fresh PASS reuse is now available.
